inference_budget: Separate from the $10 scraping allowance. Model evaluation/judging not run during data creation.
news_panels: International diplomacy, sanctions and public policy
Climate, severe weather and public health

social_policy.historical_post_content: Candidate evidence only; check publication times, edits and quoted/linked content for leakage.
social_policy.historical_engagement: Use only genuine as-of snapshots or documented timestamped metrics. Current views/comments on old posts are excluded from historical inputs.
social_policy.historical_labels: Publication/announcement targets only when source coverage can be verified; otherwise unresolved.
social_policy.prospective_track: Optional separately approved snapshots of the existing retained cohort; not enabled by this plan.

financial_target_policy: Only next-calendar-day targets containing a regular trading session. Do not silently substitute next trading day for a 24-hour horizon.

inspected_source_candidates.role: Date-bounded context and separately collected next-day reporting
inspected_source_candidates.warning: Publication date filtering does not recover historical page versions.
No historical engagement snapshot; edits and linked/quoted content need review.

inspected_source_candidates.role: Daily OHLCV numeric context and held-out next-day outcomes
inspected_source_candidates.warning: Check adjustment/revision semantics; historical bars are not proof of point-in-time data availability.

inspected_source_candidates.role: Acceptance-timestamped corporate filing evidence and outcomes
inspected_source_candidates.warning: Filter a fixed company/form cohort; absence requires complete source coverage.
Historical date support does not establish point-in-time consensus forecasts; do not ingest revised consensus as if known at cutoff.

selection_policy: Freeze dates, panels, entity cohorts and question templates before accessing target outcomes. Propose context-dependent questions using only history; do not select cases based on exciting next-day outcomes.
exclusion_policy: Unsupported historical metrics and detectable answer leakage exclude a question from the primary leaderboard. Incomplete outcome coverage produces unresolved, not false.
contamination_policy: Historical evaluation cannot prove absence of model-training contamination. Record exact model versions and known release/training metadata; keep retrospective results separate from prospective results.

data_separation.judge_input: Only after forecasts are frozen: anonymous forecast, relevant history, trusted resolution and fixed rubric

leaderboards.primary: Objective outcome scores by track: Brier for binary/categorical probabilities; MAE/interval coverage for numeric estimates; no unresolved questions scored as negative.
leaderboards.secondary: Blinded model-judge assessment of specificity, evidence fidelity, temporal discipline, uncertainty and testability. Not a replacement for outcome scoring.

reporting_policy: Report track scores, coverage/unresolved rates, calibration, latency, tokens/cost and uncertainty grouped by date/event; adjacent seven-day contexts overlap. Fifty questions is a pipeline pilot, not a definitive model ranking.
